repo.description:
### Impact
Any staff user, including a Contributor, could replace the thumbnail image of video or other media uploaded by another user, including on published posts they cannot edit. The replacement image would then appear on the published post.

The impact is limited to replacing media thumbnail images. It does not give access to other files and does not allow editing post content.

### Vulnerable versions
This vulnerability is present in Ghost from v4.22.2 up to v6.75.0.

### Patches
v6.76.0 contains a fix for this issue.

### How to update
For self-hosters using Docker, find [Docker's official Ghost image here](https://hub.docker.com/_/ghost). Updating a Docker-based Ghost instance [is documented here](https://docs.ghost.org/install/docker#updating-ghost). 

If your Ghost is a Ghost-CLI install see our documentation on [updating it to the latest version here](https://docs.ghost.org/update). 

### References
We thank Javier García Herrera for disclosing this vulnerability responsibly.

### For more information
If you have any questions or comments about this advisory, email us at [security@ghost.org](mailto:security@ghost.org).
